data.name: Hasnayn
data.gender_notes: Hasnayn is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hasnayn means 'the one who is given two gifts' or 'the one who is granted two blessings'. In Islamic history, Hasan and Husayn, the grandsons of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), are commonly referred to as Hasnayn. The name Hasnayn carries the meaning “Two Gifts” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasnayn usually hope their child will grow to embody two gifts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Receiving and cherishing blessings from Allah.
data.etymology: Hasnayn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Two Gifts.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasnayn total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Hasnayn
in_english.meaning: Beauty and goodness, derived from Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hasnayn is derived from the Arabic root 'hasana', which means to be beautiful or good. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies beauty, goodness, and righteousness. It is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's grandson, Hassan ibn Ali, who was known for his piety and moral character. The name is commonly used among Muslims worldwide and symbolizes the values of compassion, kindness, and spiritual growth.
